meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后,agent 会接入 GitHub:在 PR 和 issue 的评论线程里参与对话,被 @ 提及后回复,首次提及后该线程内后续评论也会回应。它按仓库逐个接线,每个 PR 或 issue 是独立会话。
howto.when: 当有人在仓库的 issue 评论或 PR 评论中 @ 机器人的用户名时触发;首次提及后该线程被订阅,后续评论都会回应。使用前需先完成适配器安装、凭据与接线配置。

say.text: 帮我给这个项目加上 GitHub 频道
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并装依赖,再构建验证

say.text: 把 github:acme/backend 接到我的 agent 组
say.note: 会创建 messaging group 并建立 wiring

say.text: 这是公开仓库,未注册用户用 strict 策略
say.note: 只有已注册成员能触发 agent

howto.what_en: Once installed, the agent joins GitHub PR and issue comment threads: it replies when @-mentioned, and after the first mention it answers all follow-up comments in that thread. Each PR or issue gets its own session.
howto.when_en: Triggered when someone @-mentions the bot's username in an issue comment or PR review comment; that thread is then subscribed. Setup (adapter, credentials, wiring) must be done first.

say_en.text: Add GitHub channel support to this project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, installs the dep, then builds and tests

say_en.text: Wire github:acme/backend to my agent group
say_en.note: Creates a messaging group and a wiring

say_en.text: This is a public repo — use the strict sender policy
say_en.note: Only registered members can trigger the agent
